manual_reviews.label: Privacy notice and Kit email collection
manual_reviews.reason: Confirm notice, consent language, data handling, retention, unsubscribe behavior, and any required privacy-policy link for the two forms posting to https://app.kit.com/forms/9830738/subscriptions.

manual_reviews.label: Calendly intake privacy and data transfer
manual_reviews.reason: Exercise https://calendly.com/missionarymediahub/30min and confirm the questionnaire context transfers as described, sensitive-data warning remains visible, the site keeps no copy, and Calendly disclosures are sufficient.

manual_reviews.label: Image, video, icon, and font rights
manual_reviews.reason: Confirm provenance and public/commercial-use rights for every image, the AI-generated door/hero asset, story and podcast media, icons, logo, and Source Sans 3 font files.

manual_reviews.label: External destination operations
manual_reviews.reason: Exercise the Kit subscription endpoint, Calendly booking, https://forms.gle/B32ghbgiyGa1qHLUA, and public YouTube destinations end to end; confirm ownership, availability, confirmations, and failure paths.

manual_reviews.label: Resource inventory, readiness, and destinations
manual_reviews.reason: Confirm The Supporter Map, The Two-Hour Weekly Update Rhythm, and Phone-First Editing on Slow Internet remain honestly labeled in preparation; verify each finished file, format, rights record, review date, and public URL before adding any download action.

manual_reviews.label: Production source and rollback
manual_reviews.reason: Confirm the Netlify production site is connected to the intended GitHub repository/branch and publish directory, preserve the current known-good deploy for rollback, and prevent another connected repository from overwriting it.

manual_reviews.label: Keyboard, focus, contrast, and reduced-motion runtime review
manual_reviews.reason: Browser-test keyboard order, visible focus, menus/dialogs/forms, responsive states, contrast, screen-reader names, and both CSS and JavaScript behavior with reduced motion enabled.

manual_reviews.label: Search and social metadata operations
manual_reviews.reason: Decide the canonical apex/www URL, add and validate canonical/Open Graph metadata where appropriate, and confirm robots.txt and sitemap policy before treating search readiness as complete.

manual_reviews.label: Entity and tax wording
manual_reviews.owner: Tabor / qualified legal or tax reviewer
manual_reviews.reason: Confirm the for-profit wording remains accurate and that no public copy implies an active charitable-giving route or tax-deductible status; the checker only blocks obvious contradictory public phrases.

manual_reviews.label: Owner publication approval
manual_reviews.reason: Review the rendered production site and explicitly approve publication. A clean static report is not launch authorization.

limitations: The checker performs static analysis only and always reports launch_authorized=false.
It does not fetch or submit Kit, Calendly, Google Forms, YouTube, or any other external destination.
It cannot prove privacy, security, legal/entity or tax compliance, accessibility conformance, copy truth, media rights, or owner approval.
It observes source-level focus and reduced-motion signals but cannot prove computed styles, JavaScript state, visual order, responsive behavior, or assistive-technology output.

The resource-reference check intentionally permits zero downloads while the public inventory says resources are in preparation; each future resource needs a verified file, URL, rights record, and review date.
Missing canonical and Open Graph metadata are review warnings for the current live files, not silent approval; malformed or duplicate canonical metadata remains blocking.
Approved external destination entries document the current production contract; only the matching discovery-call CTA destination is statically enforced by the CTA checker.
statement: Static analysis only. This report does not prove launch readiness, visual quality, accessibility conformance, privacy/security fitness, legal/entity compliance, copy truth, permissions, external destination operation, or publication approval.
